ns2:section.sectionText: Canoeing. Meets 14-03-05 - 04-05-05. Introductory skills and knowledge essential for handling a canoe with safety. The ability to jump or dive into deep water while clothed and maintain a survival position for 10 minutes. A one day field trip on a Friday to a local river/lake is required. First class meeting is in 121 Campus Recreation Outdoor Center (CROC). Additional class activity fee of $50.00 required which includes equipment (canoes, PFD's, paddles, etc.) and supplies used throughout the 8 week course.
